Scenario fixture: focus-not-obscured-minimum (WCAG 2.4.11) and focus-not-obscured-enhanced (WCAG 2.4.12)

Each case is a column of links, with the box the page keeps in place over it, whose id is fno_case_NN; the page has no scroll-padding. The rules need a layout, so in jsdom they report nothing: the data-outcome-* attributes give that jsdom verdict, and the browser test checks the one in each title. The links come after a tall space, so the page can scroll them under a footer. A script-made modal dialog covers the whole window, so it can't share a page with the other cases: the rules' own tests cover it, and a sticky header and scroll-padding too.
